question:
The bar graph below shows the number of boys and girls of a certain locality and the number of hours per week that they spend on playing video games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ed46e3413dd09e0d833861999d579b38877bcfb52bd64e70876d5b5231437e6.png] 

The number of boys spending more than 10 hours per week on playing video games is what percentage (rounded off to the nearest integer) more/less than the number of girls spending less than 13 hours per week on playing video games?
solution:
**Calculations:**

Total boys > 10 hrs = 79 + 33 + 94 + 76 = 282

Total girls 26% more than girls spending less than 13 hours.**
